definitions.explanation: A ship that transports passengers and cargo between two points, typically connecting to other transportation routes.

examples.japanese: {連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
{連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運航|うんこう}→運航：09229_unkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連絡船|れんらくせん}だ。
examples.english: The only means of transportation to the island is the ferry.

notes:
{連絡船|れんらくせん} refers to a ferry that connects different locations, often linking islands to the mainland or providing connections to other modes of transportation like trains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (board a ferry)
- {連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (get off a ferry)
- {連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (ferry departs)
- {連絡船|れんらくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (ferry arrives)
